headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Stonecradle Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: Since the 03:15 edition the centre of traffic has moved to the late-morning wires, with the Weathered Expanse logging four affairs in two hours to 11:56 about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch among 15 in the day to stand five Warden, four Colonial with 11,402 Colonial and 12,429 Warden casualties in 24 hours, while Stlican Shelf reports three affairs in six hours about Thornhold to 09:23 among seven in the day to stand five Warden, four Colonial with 4,223 and 4,887 losses. Linn Mercy adds affairs to 06:15 about Rotdust and Lathair among 19 in the day to hold eleven Colonial to none, and Stonecradle to 04:57 about Buckler Sound and The Reach among 18 in the day now shows three Warden, six Colonial with 11,081 and 16,776 day losses accelerating sharply in the last hour. Farranac Coast, Fisherman's Row, Gutter and Mooring County show no affairs in six hours and have gone quiet, while Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow and Nevish Line still post heavy casualty lists with no fresh flips.
